subject: Encoder handoff, registrant identity flow, and recording retention holdback
messages:
From: Jared Moss <jared.moss@acme-cloud.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Webinar: March 3rd — encoder handoff + registrant identity / recording retention

Hi Soojin / team,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We need to lock down a few operational items for Acme Cloud’s March 3rd webinar (30-min product demo + 15-min Q&A):

- Encoder handoff: our events team will bring a mobile encoder (WirelessBond 4K) and wants to send RTMP to Redwood/Zoom/ON24. We need details on expected ingest host, stream keys, recommended bitrate ladder, and whether Redwood will relay to ON24 or we should do RTMP to ON24 directly.
- Registrant identity flow: due to compliance we need to collect a unique corporate ID (Acme Customer ID) during registration and have Redwood pass a registrant_id to the session so we can watermark recordings. Is that supported on zoom -> ON24 bridge?
- Recording retention holdback: legal wants recordings to be held for 60 days before auto-release to marketing channels; we need guidance on where recordings will land (Redwood cloud bucket vs ON24 cloud) and how to set retention policy.

Can your ops lead confirm the preferred handoff windows for final full-stream tests? We’d like two dry-runs: Feb 25 (prefer morning PST) and Mar 2 (last-minute checks).

Attaching our standard equipment spec and event checklist. Also looping in Elena (legal) for retention question.

Appreciate it — Jared

--
Jared Moss
Senior Events Manager, Acme Cloud
events@acme-cloud.com
Phone: +1 415-555-0142

Attachments: acme_encoder_specs.pdf (doc stub), acme_event_checklist.xlsx (doc stub)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Jared Moss <jared.moss@acme-cloud.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Feb 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Webinar: March 3rd — encoder handoff + registrant identity / recording retention

Hi Jared — thanks for the clear list. See proposed plan below; please flag anything you need changed.

1) Encoder handoff and routing
- Preferred: RTMP -> Redwood edge -> Redwood will relay to ON24. Reason: we can apply live transcode/bitrate ladder and ensure a single failover entry point.
- If you must RTMP -> ON24 directly, provide ON24 stream key and we will monitor only.
- Ingest host / keys (for Redwood edge):
  - Primary RTMP: rtmp://ingest.use1.redwood.ai/live
  - Stream key format: acme_<eventid>_<encoderid> (we will issue keys after confirmation)
  - Recommended bitrate ladder: 5.5 Mbps (4K/30) / 3.0 Mbps (1080p) / 1.2 Mbps (720p) / 600 kbps (480p) with max B-frames disabled; profile high.

2) Registrant identity flow
- We can add a custom registration field "Acme Customer ID" in the registration form and map it to registrant_id in the session metadata. That metadata will be written to the session manifest and will be available to ON24 as a per-attendee token when we proxy the stream.
- Important: Zoom native registration field is limited; if you are using Zoom registration + ON24, we will require a small middleware pass-through (we provide a webhook endpoint that maps Zoom registration -> Redwood -> ON24). See link: https://redwood-internal.company/ops/registration-mapping (internal).

3) Recording retention and holdback
- Default flow: Redwood records to customer-isolated S3 bucket (encrypted) and writes a manifest to our audit log. If we relay to ON24 and ON24 records, we will still retain a canonical copy in Redwood (assuming relay mode).
- Retention: we can set a 60-day auto-delete policy on the Redwood copy. We can also apply a manual release workflow (legal needs to sign off in ticket) before we push copies to marketing drives.

4) Suggested test windows
- Dry-run A: Thu Feb 25, 09:30–10:15 PT (encoder + registration webhook + recording)
- Dry-run B: Mon Mar 2, 16:00–16:45 PT (last mile and scale test)

Attachments: webinar_encoder_checklist_20260218.pdf (checklist with steps + monitoring URLs). I’ve attached the checklist and a template for the registration field mapping.

Next steps: Jared, can you confirm which routing mode (Redwood relay vs direct ON24) you prefer and who on your side will provide the encoder handoff window? Also please add Elena (legal) as the retention approver.

Thanks — Soojin

--
Soojin Lee
Senior Events Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

2) Provide a short checklist itemizing what metadata will be stored with the recording (registrant_id, IP, timestamp, and session manifest). We need that for our compliance team.
